title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record preserves source-checkable modern LaTeX working drafts, translations, source witnesses, render checks, and audit support for the Noether corpus.

Status at a glance. These files are working drafts and source-audit artifacts, not a certified critical edition. The current German/source-audit baseline staged here is 115 Noether - R124plusP40 P35 P36 P38 P39 Rebased Source Repairs 2026-06-24.zip. It carries R124, the local Paper 40 printed pp.514-541 repair, and the rebased P35/P36/P38/P39 source repairs. File 112 Noether - German R124 plus P40 Full Range Best Available Source Repair 2026-06-24.zip remains preserved as the earlier fronting baseline/provenance layer.

Known caveat. Paper 40 uses the best staged local GDZ witness at native 400 ppi. That is below the preferred 650+ ppi threshold for final source certification and below the 1000+ ppi preference for dense mathematical material. The P40 repair should therefore be treated as best-available source repair work, not final high-resolution certification.

Survival audit cluster. File 114 Noether - R124plusP40 Survival NoNewPatch Audit Cluster 2026-06-24.zip aggregates Papers 09-20 survival/no-new-patch checks for the current R124+P40 baseline. It preserves audit evidence that prior source-critical repairs and known no-fix traps survive; it does not introduce a new canonical TeX body patch and is not whole-paper or whole-corpus certification.

Multilingual status. English, Spanish, Japanese, French, Chinese, Ukrainian, Russian, Interslavic, and other language branches are useful working translations, but remain downstream of the German/source audit line. The Slavic package is included as a work-so-far translation and linguistics lane, not source-certified closure.

GitHub mirror. Corrections, issue reports, and pull requests can be made through the public GitHub mirror.

Rebased current Noether source-repair update. This version adds file 115, the current best local German cumulative TeX/PDF line after rebasing P35/P36/P38/P39 source repairs onto the R124+P40 baseline, and file 116, a narrow P34 p641/p660 hotspot no-new-patch disposition. These are working source-audit/provenance packages, not critical editions or whole-corpus certification; P35/P36/P38/P39 use best-staged 600ppi witnesses and P34/P40 still rely on best-available 400ppi GDZ witnesses where noted.

Slavic translation/language-lane update. This version adds file 117, a public-safe Ukrainian/Russian/Interslavic/Interslavic-Cyrillic work-so-far package through Papers 01-33 and Paper 34 section 02. It includes cumulative readers, TeX, terminology logs, the Interslavic logbook, constructed-language reflections, infrastructure provenance, and audit metadata. Modern third-party reference PDFs used for terminology triangulation were deliberately excluded from the public package. Treat this as a rendered/audited working multilingual translation lane, not a critical edition or independent source-perfect certification.

Public-safe cleanup note. The raw Slavic work-so-far ZIP previously staged as file 110 has been removed from the current version and replaced by the curated public-safe file 117. File 117 keeps the Ukrainian/Russian/Interslavic translation outputs and project logbooks while excluding modern third-party reference PDFs used only for terminology triangulation.

Paper 30 source-repair update. This version adds file 118, a working source-repair package for Paper 30 printed pp. 46-48 and 53-54. It restores source-visible footnotes 27 and 28 and corrects the §9 Axiom IV display against best-available local IA/JP2-derived witnesses. The witnesses remain below the strict 650+ ppi final-certification floor, so file 118 should be treated as a source-confirmed working correction package, not as whole-paper or critical-edition certification.

Paper 30 anchor-closed source-repair update. This version replaces the earlier file 118 with an expanded Paper 30 working source-repair package. The new file 118 retains the footnote 27/28 and section 9 Axiom IV repairs, adds the source-style printed p. 61 received-date repair, and records visual dispositions for the remaining Paper 30 OCR-anchor failure pages. The witnesses remain below the strict 650+ ppi final-certification floor, so this is a working repair and disposition package rather than whole-paper or critical-edition certification.

Post-R124 survival rollup. This version adds file 119, 119 Noether - PostR124 Survival Rollup NoNewPatch Audit 2026-06-24.zip. It collects compact Local Codex survival/no-new-patch results checked against the latest local R124-plus current candidate. It is an audit/status layer: most entries confirm that earlier repairs survive or that source-quality blockers remain, rather than introducing a new canonical TeX body patch. It is not whole-paper certification, whole-corpus certification, or a critical edition.
notes: Latest staging replaces file 118 with the Paper 30 anchor-closed footnote/formula/date repair and visual-disposition package, below strict 650+ ppi final certification. Latest staging adds file 118: Paper 30 source-confirmed working repair for footnotes 27/28 and the §9 Axiom IV display, below strict 650+ ppi final certification. Latest staging fronts the rebased R124+P40 German cumulative source-repair line with P35/P36/P38/P39 restored source repairs, adds a narrow P34 hotspot no-new-patch disposition, and retains the compact P09-P20 survival/no-new-patch audit cluster. This is not a critical edition. P35/P36/P38/P39 are based on best-staged 600ppi witnesses below the strict 650+ floor; P34/P40 GDZ400 loci remain below final high-resolution certification; downstream translations should be treated as working drafts. Both are best-available-below-650 source-support/intake only and should be deliberately compacted before any Noether rollup. Latest local P30 update: the MA96/IAJP2 source-status payload now has a compact ZIP (102,382,074 bytes, SHA256 8302E672012229E67ECDE2918F71CBBB05712B63C950D657E840A1C5B87B9C42) for printed pp.26-61, but it remains source-witness/provenance below strict 650+ppi certification. Compact P30 pp.26-55 source-fix ZIPs now exist with README/ledger/checksum material and targeted German TeX/PDF/diff/source-witness evidence, but they remain below strict source-certification floor and do not close Paper 30. Fold all P30 material into a deliberate compact Noether rollup after file-ceiling pruning rather than uploading loose.
